rationale: Genome-wide knockout screen (TKOv3-style library, 90,709 guides, no non-targeting controls) in Daudi-Cas9 cells co-cultured with primary Vg9Vd2 T cells from three donors (E:T 1:4, 1:4, 1:2). The paper compares surviving cells after killing with the pre-kill population; knockouts that protect from gamma-delta killing (BTN3A1, BTN2A1, mevalonate pathway) are enriched, sensitizers depleted. Each donor co-culture is one replicate of the killing condition against a single pre-kill library, so condition is the only term (2 residual df). The pre-kill library is sampled before co-culture, so fitness effects during the co-culture also contribute to depletion.
